system.effect:
A one-use gadget cobbled from materials at hand. Pick one effect when you build it:

  • Bypass: your Engineering roll against one small mechanical obstacle within reach — a sensor, a simple latch, a drawer — is at −1 Difficulty. It doesn't work on a lock the heist names as its key obstacle.
  • Boost: hand it to a crewmate for +2 dice on their next roll.
  • Distraction: set it off in a target square within 6, pulling every nearby NPC's attention there for one round.
system.description: The Tinkerer's specialty. The ST can veto materials that clearly aren't available.
